name: dankeen
description: Dan Keen's Claude Code plugins: isolated git worktrees per feature, and an orchestrated ticket-to-PR workflow.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: just recipes and scripts for one isolated git worktree per branch, with optional per-worktree setup hooks.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Ticket-to-draft-PR workflow run by subagents: build, three parallel reviews, fix loop, push, PR; also as a Workflow script (/build-ticket <ticket> ultracode). Includes /pr, /rodney-tips, /review, /ui-review, /testing-review, /testing, /unslop.
